data.title: 美狄亚 · 魔术师的海滨玻璃瓶
data.description: 【希腊风海湾·午后】美狄亚穿着紫蓝色泳装与轻便罩衫，坐在潮池旁把贝壳、海玻璃和海水装进小瓶；瓶中映出一枚微光魔法阵，她抬眼朝镜头微笑，像把海边的宁静也封存了。
data.action: 潮池旁把贝壳海玻璃装入小瓶，微光魔法阵映出整片海湾
data.lighting: soft afternoon light on clear tide pools
data.mood: 把假日变成精密小魔术
data.promptProse: Medea (Caster) from Fate wears a violet-blue wrap swimsuit with a light hooded cover-up, shell bracelets and a clear glass bottle. She sits beside a tide pool arranging shells and sea glass inside a clear little bottle. A faint magical circle glows in the water, and she looks up with quiet satisfaction as if she has preserved the entire cove in one careful spell. soft afternoon light on clear tide pools.
